- Fixed the lobby showing the your-turn highlight on a game that's actually frozen waiting on the other player to answer a pending decision (Suspicion/Compulsion-style).
- Fixed Contempt silently doing nothing when only its target mood was chosen without also selecting a mode -- it now warns before submitting a play that wouldn't do anything.
- Fixed Guilt to be a truly optional choice (a dropped "you may" in the original card text had wrongly made it mandatory), matching Contempt and Hesitation's identical wording.
